events.description: The deponent's son was held in pre-trial custody, in solitary confinement, at Thunder Bay and Kenora jails from June 4, 2012 to December 6, 2016
events.quote:
For approximately 4.5 years from June 4, 2012 to December 6, 2016, my son was held 
in pre-trial custody

events.description: From 2012 to 2016 the deponent had a Bell home phone package, long-distance plan and internet
events.quote:
From 2012 to 2016, my monthly home phone package from Bell was approximately 
$55

events.description: The deponent accepted many collect calls from his son and received large bills, some over $1,000
events.quote:
I had to accept many collect calls to 
maintain basic contact with him

events.description: Bell bill with $697.02 in collect calls

Bell bill with $553.22 in collect calls
Bell bill with $642.39 in collect calls
The son was again held in the Kenora Jail and collect-call bills were again large
events.quote: In 2017 my son was held in the Kenora Jail again.

events.quote:
For 
a 21-minute call on the July 2017 bill

events.description: The court held that the government violated the son's Charter rights by his prolonged solitary confinement
events.quote: The court decided that the government violated my son's Charter rights
